shared_elements: human or humanoid figure in relief
carved stone monument with figural imagery
stylized headdress or head covering on a figure
low-relief carving with outlined forms and patterned infill
justification: Both depict a human-like figure rendered in low relief amid dense ornament, with elaborate headgear and plant-like or scroll-filled surrounding motifs, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a single winged, bearded profile figure with an arm raised beside a stylized flowering plant, whereas B shows a tall vertical shaft crammed with frontal, stacked masklike and glyph-like blocks and a small seated onlooker beside it — the compositional schemes, figure orientation and ornamental vocabulary are quite unrelated.
